method: hand-written from Mastodon 4.7.5's MediaAttachment#populate_meta and #video_metadata (app/models/media_attachment.rb: META_KEYS focus, colors, original, small; original from VideoMetadataExtractor's width, height, frame_rate as a Rational, which JSON writes "30/1", duration and bitrate, compacted, so audio has no width, height or frame_rate; small from image_geometry of the thumbnail) and ActivityPub::NoteSerializer::MediaAttachmentSerializer (app/serializers/activitypub/note_serializer.rb: width and height from meta.original, duration as meta.original.duration.seconds.iso8601); the values are the documentation's MediaAttachment examples (docs.joinmastodon.org, entities/MediaAttachment); not run against Mastodon
